### 📓 Docs Drift Check
⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/skills/README.md`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files. Nothing else in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **1** changed package(s)).

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/skills/README.md`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **7** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 05b28c199b7408da7ca4bc3988635fa9342cd6de` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f0b0ddc2de357c1cf9b049b356eb7266a4be90e1`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/README.md, skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md + content/docs/ai/skills.mdx, content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx, content/docs/upgrading.mdx, packages/skills/package.json, packages/skills/scripts/sync-catalog.mjs, scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs, .github/workflows/lint.yml

Inputs: card #24974 (body and both comments: the dispatch claim and the os-dev-report), PR #25023 (body, four-file list, net diff against `main` at the head), the head's check-runs; the governed files read at the head and at `origin/main` with `git show`, the cited docs pages at `origin/main`. The remainder of the diff, `packages/skills/README.md` and `.changeset/24974-skills-install-line.md`, is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`; it is read here only where a governed hunk makes a claim about it. Judged from the seat of the customer agent that loads `skills/**` whole with `npx skills add`: the accept set is what that agent does when it follows these pages.

### ① Derived judgments

**J1 · `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md`, re-install step: the `pnpm add -D …` runnable line, npm and yarn on a comment line — RIGHT.**
- Accept set. In a pnpm project (the scaffolded population: `create-objectstack` installs with pnpm when it is available, card table) the block run as-is does the right thing. In an npm or yarn project the runnable line is the one silent path: `pnpm add` exits 0 and converts the project (a `pnpm-lock.yaml` beside the project's own lockfile, `node_modules` rebuilt in pnpm's layout). The old line had the mirror defect, loud (exit 1, `edgesOut`), on the larger population.
- Where the rule sits. The sentence the agent reads before it copies the block now ends "add `@objectstack/skills` at the installed spec's version with the manager that installed the project, copy it:" (L121-123 at the head); the comment line gives the swap as a prefix change on an identical argument; a literal copy of the comment's `@…` fails loud (`No matching version found`), never silently. No prose block is one an agent cannot get wrong mechanically, and the card forbids the only mechanical closure (⛔ No new gate; a lockfile-detection line would be a rule the docs do not carry). The rule in the step's own sentence is the closest placement a procedure allows.
- Against the card's "same shape as the docs": the bash block is byte-identical to `content/docs/upgrading.mdx` L108-113 (the docs' own version of this step) and to `content/docs/ai/skills.mdx` L32-34 (PR #24973, merged). The docs carry the rule as a paragraph after the block; the skill carries it in the step sentence before it. Equal accept set, fewer tokens, paid under the ratchet.
- Against the PR body's reasoning: the rejected three-line form (one runnable line per manager) is rightly rejected. An agent executing step by step runs all three; a placeholder line is not runnable.
- Residual, not blocking: the skill's sentence names the rule without its failure mode (both READMEs and both docs pages say "exits `1`"). The charter's "每条经验自含失效模式与边界" is the standard; the ratchet's 17 tokens of headroom is the reason. The block's comment line is the boundary; the seat may spend a later ratchet-paying edit on the failure mode.

**J2 · The § 2.1 cut ("Their consumer-facing projection is `spec-changes.json` and the chain's own `--json` output") — RIGHT, the content survives.**
Both named objects have a home in the same § 2.1 ("Harvest the instruction sources — all of them ship"), above the callout: the table rows **Chain result** (`os migrate meta --from N --json` → `.specChanges`, marked "Start here") and **D4 projection** (`node_modules/@objectstack/spec/spec-changes.json`, "the same data for every major, offline"), and the bash block under them that reads `spec-changes.json`. An agent reading the "Not reachable" callout learns "not there"; the redirect is the table the callout sits under, and the row name "D4 projection" keeps the thread. What is lost is one explicit back-link, not a rule: the callout's rule ("do not send anyone there") stands whole. Charter: "砍点逐条核幸存,被砍内容若在别处无家,砍掉就是丢规则" — checked, it has a home.

**J3 · The dropped `--all` branch in the re-install prose — RIGHT.**
The old prose offered `--all` "when they are the project's only skills", a judgment with no listing step before it. The card's second Wanted line binds "where a site prints `npx skills remove --all`"; this site printed the by-name command and named `--all` only in prose, so the card's literal remedy (`npx skills list` before it) does not bind here. Dropping the branch leaves one command that is always safe (a missing name is skipped), the same by-name command `content/docs/upgrading.mdx` L108-110 prints with no `--all`; it is stricter than list-first at −52 bytes. No `--all` survives in `skills/**` at the head other than `--allow-destructive` (git grep). Equal or safer accept set.

**J4 · `skills/README.md` (ships as `dist/skills/README.md`: `sync-catalog.mjs` copies `skills/**` byte-identical) — RIGHT.** The pnpm line, the comment line, and the rule in its short form ("in a pnpm project, `npm install --save-dev` exits `1`") opening the paragraph after the block. The page defers detail to the Skills reference, and that target carries it: `content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx` L28 names the `edgesOut` error, L34 the `npx skills list` guard before `npx skills remove --all` for scaffolded projects. Same accept set as the docs page it mirrors.

**Budget and surface readings (the gates' readings, not mine).** `skills/**` net +2 against the dispatch's +4 (`git diff --numstat` from the merge base `62bc12930`: README +11/−8, SKILL.md +6/−7), paid by the two deletions J2 and J3 name, not by re-wrap. The token ratchet and `check:skill-docs` run in `Type Check · source gates`: success. No npm-only runnable line survives under `skills/` or `packages/skills/` at the head outside comment lines and the prose naming the failure.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/24974-skills-install-line.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, `Clause-②: no`. Matches what the diff publishes: prose only, all of it inside `@objectstack/skills` — `README.md` is in the package's `files[]`, and `skills/README.md` and `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` ship under `dist/` through `sync-catalog.mjs`. No schema, export or authorable key moves, so `Clause-②: no` with no arm is right; the PR body carries the same line. `skip-changeset` would have been wrong (it publishes), and patch is the level a docs fix in a released package takes. The changeset's three claims (both pages' line; `ERR_PNPM_NO_MATCHING_VERSION` beside `ETARGET`; `npx skills list` before `npx skills remove --all`) each match the diff. `Check Changeset`: success.

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions`: empty. Dev deviations, each answered:
1. `--all` clause dropped — J3, right.
2. `ETARGET` → `ERR_PNPM_NO_MATCHING_VERSION` on `packages/skills/README.md` — the remainder (lane ACCEPT), noted: the wording is `content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx` L34's and the code is pnpm's; consistent.
3. § 2.1 sentence deleted — J2, right.
4. `skills/README.md` rule in short form — J4, the link target carries the text; right.
5. Three derived gates NOT MEASURED locally (`check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`) — their reading is CI's; the check-runs below are the verdicts.
6. `origin/main` moved during the run, not merged — right: no conflict (`mergeable: true`), the merge base is unchanged.
7. No label writes — the PR's `documentation`, `size/s`, `tooling` are Auto Label's (its check-run: success); consistent.
8. Commit trailer pair — verified on the head: `Claude-Session` plus the model-free `Co-authored-by` trailer, no model identifier; right per AGENTS.md, and the harness reminder's own precedence sentence yields to it.
9. dogfood not run — docs-only diff, nothing to boot; right.

Out-of-scope finding, ESCALATED to the seat as a filing decision: `packages/skills/CHANGELOG.md` (two released entries, L40 and L199 at `origin/main`) print the npm-only line as "the same two-step install the docs give", and `packages/create-objectstack/CHANGELOG.md` (L28, L140) offers `npx skills remove --all` without a listing step. Both ship in the tarballs as the text an upgrading agent greps (AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails). The dev's "not class a" reading is contestable — the card itself was filed as class a, a documented command that fails, measured — and the guardrail names the remedy (a dedicated docs-only PR amending the entry), which this PR rightly does not carry. Not a FAIL here; the dev's dedupe words are in the os-dev-report.

Tier: `skills/**` is Tier H. This record is the contract-tier review the dispatch claim owes; the landing still waits on the maintainer's APPROVED review, and the PR stands as it must — draft, no auto-merge, no reviewers, head repo equal to base.

Check-runs on the head, read at 2026-10-21T01:38Z: 32 completed/success, among them `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Build Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Changeset`, `Type Check · source gates` and `Test Core` (2/6) to (6/6); 7 completed/skipped (opt-in and path-filtered: `18.x upgrade harness`, `Packed-tarball smoke`, `Build Docs`, `Console Pin Gate`, the dogfood shards, `Dogfood Verify CLI`, `Temporal Conformance`); 1 in_progress, NOT MEASURED: `Test Core (1/6)`. Its conclusion is the gate's, to be read before any landing act; nothing in this diff is a test input.

## 维护者速读

**改了什么**:三处面向客户的安装说明原本只给一行 `npm install --save-dev …`,现在改给 pnpm 的那一行,旁边一行注释写出 npm 和 yarn 的拼法,并写明规则「用安装这个项目的包管理器来加包」。三处是:
- npm 包页 README;
- 技能目录首页 README;
- 升级技能(`objectstack-upgrade`)里的重装步骤。

npm 包页还补了两点:17.x 项目报错时 pnpm 给的错误码;执行 `npx skills remove --all` 之前先跑 `npx skills list`。附一条 `@objectstack/skills` 的 patch changeset。

**为什么改**:`create-objectstack` 装项目时有 pnpm 就用 pnpm,所以脚手架出来的项目大多是 pnpm 项目。在这种项目里照抄原来那一行,会直接报错退出(实测 exit 1),什么也装不上。文档站的三页已在 PR #24973 改好,这三处是同一问题剩下的、跟着包发出去的部分。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:
- 纯文字改动,不碰代码、不加门禁。
- `skills/**` 两个文件合计净增 2 行,在 +4 的预算内。为付升级技能的 token 棘轮,删了一句与上方表格重复的话,复核确认信息仍在表里。
- 已知边界:升级技能的块里,可直接运行的那行是 pnpm。agent 若在 npm 项目里照块原样执行,会用 pnpm 去装。所以把规则写进了块前面那句步骤说明里,这也是文档站的同一做法。
- 回滚:revert 这一个提交。

**席位意见**:建议批准。达档契约复核(评论 6305865486)从「加载这些技能的客户 agent」的视角逐段判过,结论 PASS:
- 安装块与文档站两页逐字一致;
- 删掉的那句,内容仍在同一节的表格里;
- 去掉 `--all` 的简写,只留按名删除这一条总是安全的命令,比原来更稳。

复核另提到两条旧版本 CHANGELOG 条目也印着 npm 那一行。席位判断不立卡:那些条目如实记录了当时发出去的内容,不是事实错误。

**你要做的**:在 PR #25023 上点 Approve,席位随后落地。

## 席位核对

ACCEPT · `domain:skills` seat 1 (seat post #7623) · `session_01M82feuetLzrCiBz41BJb7L` · head `f0b0ddc2de357c1cf9b049b356eb7266a4be90e1` · 2026-10-21T01:45Z

1. **Form.** The PR is a draft against `main`, and the body's first line is `Fixes #24974`. Assignee `huangyiirene` equals the card's. Files: `packages/skills/README.md`, `skills/README.md`, `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` and `.changeset/24974-skills-install-line.md`. `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 25023`: Tier H, +43/−21. The changeset is right: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, `Clause-②: no`. The package's `README.md` is in its `files[]`, and the two `skills/**` files ship under `dist/`.
2. **Premises measured.** The seat read the whole diff. `skills/**` is net +2 against the dispatch's +4 budget. The token ratchet on the upgrade skill reads 6171/6188.
   - The remainder at `TIER_DEFAULT` is `packages/skills/README.md` and the changeset. The seat checked it: pnpm line, comment line and rule as in PR #24973; `ERR_PNPM_NO_MATCHING_VERSION` beside `ETARGET`; `npx skills list` before `npx skills remove --all`. Each matches the changeset's three claims.
3. **Gate check-runs**, pinned to this head (2026-10-21T01:44Z): 41 complete, 0 pending, 0 failures. `check-expected-skips.mjs --pr 25023`, from a checkout pinned to `origin/main` `73432299c`: `OK — 7 skipped check-run(s), every one in main's roster (exit 0)`. The contract review of record is comment 6305865486 (`Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, this head, `Local-runs: none`, **PASS**), rendered by an isolated subagent at that tier and adopted by this seat.
4. **Accepted deviations.**
   - The `--all` branch is dropped from the upgrade prose (review J3).
   - The § 2.1 sentence is cut to pay the ratchet, and its content survives in the same section's table (review J2).
   - `ETARGET` gains its pnpm sibling.
   - `skills/README.md` carries the rule in its short form, with the link target carrying the detail (review J4).
   - The model-free commit trailers follow AGENTS.md.
5. **Out-of-scope findings.** The released `packages/skills/CHANGELOG.md` entries (L40, L199) and `packages/create-objectstack/CHANGELOG.md` entries (L28, L140) were escalated by the review as a filing decision. The seat's decision is dropped, for these reasons:
   - The skills entries accurately record the two-step install the READMEs shipped at that release.
   - The create-objectstack entries say "run your package manager's install", and guard `remove --all` with "if you installed no others".
   - AGENTS.md's released-entry remedy covers a factual error in the entry, and neither entry states one.
6. **Landing.** Tier H, so this PR stays draft. Review is requested from both authorised approvers, and the card moves to `needs-user-decision`. On an authorised APPROVED review the seat clears the label, flips the PR ready, arms auto-merge, follows it to MERGED and closes out #24974.
